messages.author: fecbe3dc811bed89
messages.subject: How to save mod <- mirt()
parts:
Hi Phil,

If mod <- mirt(), what is the best way to save mod? I found R cannot regonize the mod object whenever I updated mirt package.

I always used save(cmod, file="cmod_NM") and load("cmod_NM").

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: How to save mod <- mirt()
parts:
Unfortunately, there is no guaranteed way that will work when updating (the same is true for other packages). I may add or remove slots from the objects, and therefore the only sure way to save things is to rerun the scripts after updating.

Pro tip: I would use saveRDS instead of save if you are only exporting one object at a time. Cheers.

Phil
